 Mr M. V. Rai, Advocate for the Applicants.

Ms M. H. Deshmukh, Addl. P. P. for the Non-Applicant No.
 Coram : Vinay Joshi And Valmiki Sa Menezes, Jj.
 Date : 15th February, 2023.
 . Heard.
2.

This is an application seeking to quash the First Information Report (FIR) in Crime No.985 of 2020, registered with M.I.D.C. Police Station, District Nagpur, for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506 and 323 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and related charge- sheet.
3. It is the Applicants' case that the allegations made in FIR are vague which do not constitute an offence.
4. Issue notice to the Non-Applicants, returnable after four weeks.
The learned Additional Public Prosecutor waives notice on behalf of Non-Applicant No.1/State.
(VALMIKI SA MENEZES, J.) (VINAY JOSHI, J.) TAMBE Digitally Signed By:ASHISH ASHOKRAO TAMBE Personal Assistant to Hon'ble JUDGE Signing Date:16.02.2023 18:40
